comment: The admin SPA's own CHROME vocabulary — every string the runtime renders that does not come from the project's schema. It is data rather than a code scan because the compiler has to seed the admin's .po with it, and a Go-side extractor over TypeScript would be a parser nobody wants to own. This file is the canonical copy; `make sync-admin-vocab` mirrors it into the admin emitter and `make check-admin-vocab` fails on drift. A vitest test asserts every t("…") literal in src/ appears here, so a string added to a component cannot silently go untranslated. Spec: docs/specs/i18n/formatting.md.
